Building and bases

Check four things before choosing a base site

Before spending all your materials on a large base, walk around the site. Check whether it is visible from a busy road, whether wood, stone and metal are nearby, whether you have a practical route home with loot, and whether there is room for more doors, storage or another floor.

If the site cannot offer everything, a solo player can first prioritize a small, lockable shelter and a return route they know well. A resource-rich spot is not automatically worth building beside a busy path. Place a Tool Cupboard, door, respawn point and a little storage, then watch local player traffic over several gathering trips before expanding.

This is a way to compare locations, not a promise that any terrain is safe. Map layout, server population and nearby players change the risk. Do not copy coordinates from someone else’s video without checking the site yourself.
